invariants.expression: **Neutrino mass-ordering prediction = NORMAL ORDERING** (closes one of the two thin gaps from the Mendeleev scan INV-5278). **Framework logic** (5-tuple taxonomy, INV-5245/5276): neutrinos are σ_BF-trivial partners to charged leptons, sharing region (Shilov) AND winding-mode W_n per generation (gen1=W_0, gen2=W_1, gen3=W_2 for BOTH). Charged leptons are normally ordered (m_e<m_μ<m_τ). **⟹ neutrinos INHERIT the same winding order: m_ν1 < m_ν2 < m_ν3 = NORMAL ORDERING.** **Consistency**: current global fits weakly favor NO (~2-2.7σ) ✓; Δm²_31/Δm²_21 = 33.6 ≈ N_c·c_2 = 33 (INV-5245, 1.6%); if NO with m_ν1→small, m_ν3/m_ν2 = √(N_c·c_2) ≈ 5.74. **FALSIFIER**: JUNO/DUNE will settle ordering directly; INVERTED ordering would FALSIFY the shared-W_n assignment.

(b) does that rigorously force the bulk topological θ to 0 (vs merely suggest it)? (c) is the bulk-θ / boundary-CKM CP-asymmetry rigorous? Each is a real formalization step.
